note: Static dependency and fail-behavior disclosure — not a live uptime page. Current signed customer path: POST /receipt/v1. POST /verify is legacy v2 compatibility.

components.launch_console: static, Vercel-hosted; no backend, no keys in browser code
components.hosted_verifier: Render-hosted backend; the current POST /receipt/v1 path depends on its availability
components.legacy_v2: POST /verify remains legacy v2 compatibility and is not recommended for new integrations
components.pubkey: public, no auth; discovery/cross-check only, never the source of initial signer trust
components.healthz: indicates verifier availability and signer presence
components.solana_rpc: server-side only; network/RPC availability can affect checks; callers can never supply rpcUrl (rejected 400)

fail_behavior.verifier_error: fail closed — current receipt-v1 returns an unsigned refusal and issues no receipt, never guessed evidence
fail_behavior.signer_unavailable: current receipt-v1 returns an unsigned refusal and issues no receipt when signing cannot be completed
graceful_fallback: use MCP local (npx -y raven-verify-mcp) only for unsigned developer output; it is not a signed receipt-v1 fallback

hard_rules: no API keys in browser code
no secret logging — sanitized ledger only
no signatures/private keys/API keys in logs

resilience.backoff: Integrators back off on 429, 5xx, and timeouts; repeated verifier failures should trigger operator escalation, not optimistic retries.
resilience.rateLimitsAreSafetyControls: Per-key rate limits protect Raven and integrators from verification loops, quota exhaustion, and batch abuse - they are safety controls, not just cost controls.
resilience.unavailabilityIsBlocked: Verifier unavailability is a blocked/deferred state for material action; /healthz indicates availability but is not a receipt.
resilience.cachedReceipts: Cached exact receipts may be used only within staleness policy and never for a delayed material action without reverification.
